props.name: options
props.description: Columns, from one end of the scale to the other. Defaults to five-point agreement.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled answers, keyed by statement id.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every answer after one changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the whole matrix, such as the survey question.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Show the answered count and bar.

props.name: showErrors
props.description: Mark unanswered required statements as errors — set it after a submit attempt.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name prefix; each row submits as `${name}[statementId]`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the matrix.
